stem: What does relatively high alkalinity most directly indicate about a water source?
choices: It has greater acid-neutralizing capacity and may resist pH change more strongly when acid or base is added during adjustment
It probably has the highest EC among available sources because alkalinity and conductivity rise together in a predictable ratio
It likely contains very few dissolved minerals because high alkalinity mainly reflects dissolved gases rather than ionic compounds
It should create nearly identical root-zone conditions across substrates because alkalinity determines how media retain irrigation water
rationale: Alkalinity describes acid-neutralizing capacity. It helps explain why two sources with similar measured pH can require different amounts of acid to produce the same pH change.
